# Riverbank, Hella

Five self-catering apartments in the old bank building at Thrudvangur 5, 850 Hella,
South Iceland, on the bank of the river Ranga. Direct booking contact: Harpa.

## The apartments
- The Penthouse: A luxury self-catering apartment of 160 square metres: four bedrooms, two bathrooms, beds for eight, fully equipped kitchen, free wifi, a washer/dryer and a balcony overlooking the garden and the River Rangá. The largest apartment in the building, with plenty of space for a large family or a group of friends to relax and socialise after a day of exploring. https://riverbank.is/penthouse
- The One-Bedrooms: Four luxury self-catering apartments of 55 square metres, each with a large double bed, a sofa bed, fully equipped kitchen, free wifi and a washer/dryer. Spacious apartments, perfect for smaller families, groups of friends or couples travelling together. Each apartment is let separately. They are set side by side, which makes them ideal for larger groups: book two together and they comfortably sleep up to eight guests. https://riverbank.is/one-bedrooms

## Where it is
In the village of Hella, on Route 1. Coordinates 63.8356, -20.4023, geocoded
from the street address. Free parking at the door.

Within a walk of the building, straight-line metres measured on OpenStreetMap:
- Petrol (Olís): about 78 m
- Grocery store (Kjörbúðin supermarket): about 105 m
- Sports hall (Íþróttahúsið Hellu): about 156 m
- Swimming pool (Sundlaugin Hellu, the local geothermal swimming pool and hot tubs): about 169 m
- Pharmacy (Apótekarinn): about 183 m
- Bakery (Bakarí Konditori): about 186 m

By road from the door, routed on the OpenStreetMap road network. Driving times are
free-flow estimates and real winter driving is slower:
- Seljalandsfoss: 34.5 km, about 32 minutes
- Skógafoss: 61.2 km, about 55 minutes
- Þórsmörk: 63 km. By highland bus from the Hella supermarket, June to September
- Geysir: 76.1 km, about 68 minutes
- Gullfoss: 83.3 km, about 74 minutes
- Þingvellir: 85.3 km, about 82 minutes
- Reynisfjara: 93.9 km, about 83 minutes
- Reykjavík: 94.1 km, about 87 minutes
- Landmannalaugar: 98.2 km, about 105 minutes. Highland F-road, summer only, four-wheel drive required
- Keflavík Airport: 130.2 km, about 119 minutes

Distances measured on OpenStreetMap and routed with OSRM, 1 September 2026.

## Winter, October to April
On 21 December the sun rises at 11:11 and sets at 15:29:
about 4 hours 20 minutes of daylight and roughly 13 hours of true
darkness, computed for these coordinates. Mid November gives 6 hours 40 minutes of
daylight and mid February 8 hours 40 minutes.

The northern lights are visible from the building and there is a photograph taken from it
at https://riverbank.is/winter. Nobody can promise an aurora: it needs a clear sky and an active night.

Guests have reviewed stays in all 12 months of the year, and
32 of the 177 published reviews are from stays between
October and April. Those 32 are printed in full at https://riverbank.is/winter.

## What guests say
9.7 out of 10 across 95 reviews on Booking.com, and
4.99 out of 5 across 82 reviews on Airbnb, both read
31 August 2026. Every review is published in full at https://riverbank.is/guests. The two scores are
never averaged together: the scales differ and so do the samples.

## Common questions
Q: Can you see the northern lights from Riverbank?
A: Yes. The aurora photograph at the top of this page was taken from the building itself. Hella sits far enough from Reykjavík that the sky goes properly dark, and from October to April the nights are long, so on a clear night you can step straight outside and look up.

Q: How dark does it get in Hella in winter?
A: On 21 December the sun rises at 11:11 and sets at 15:29, which is about 4 hours 20 minutes of daylight and roughly 13 hours a night of true darkness. By mid November it is 6 hours 40 minutes of daylight, and by mid February 8 hours 40 minutes.

Q: Is Riverbank open in winter?
A: Yes. Guests have reviewed stays in all twelve months, and 32 of the 177 published reviews are from stays between October and April.

Q: How far is Riverbank from Reykjavík and the airport?
A: Reykjavík is 94 kilometres by road on Route 1, and Keflavík International Airport is 130 kilometres, on Route 1 and then Route 41. Allow well over the free-flow driving times in winter conditions.

Q: Is there a shop nearby, and somewhere to swim?
A: The grocery store is 105 metres from the door on foot, the pharmacy and the bakery a couple of minutes further, and the local geothermal swimming pool and hot tubs 169 metres. Parking is free at the door.

Q: Do the apartments have kitchens?
A: Every apartment is self-catering with its own private kitchen and a dishwasher, and every one has a washer/dryer. In the low season, when fewer places are serving food late, that is the difference between cooking and driving.

Q: Do you need to book far ahead for a winter stay?
A: Usually not. Winter is the quiet season at Riverbank, so nights between October and April are often still free a few weeks out, and one night is enough to book. Summer is the opposite: many summer bookings arrive as early as February.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: No. Riverbank has a no-pets policy at present.

## Booking
Choose dates and see the total at https://riverbank.is. Harpa reviews availability before any payment;
email harpa@riverbank.is or message her on WhatsApp at +354 864 6817.
A request is not a booking confirmation. The same apartments
are on Booking.com and Airbnb; booking direct reaches the same hosts without the
